purpose: Project-specific model selection before any production model or pool allocation change.

evaluation_contract.semantic_evaluation: Every structured task has explicit expected invariants; semantic_pass is false on any failed assertion.
evaluation_contract.code_execution: Code patches are applied only to a disposable temporary copy; expected behavior is checked by task-specific file assertions and focused tests.
evaluation_contract.tool_use: Tool tasks execute a bounded two-turn model→tool→result→model loop and validate tool name, arguments, result handling, final semantics, and scope.
evaluation_contract.reliability: Repeat-level success, consistency, and hard-failure rate are reported separately and aggregated into reliability.
evaluation_contract.security: Credentials are obtained only through the protected store and never emitted into benchmark outputs.
